messages:
alex: taking over morning on-call, quick summary of last night so the handoff is compact. 02:12 UTC we saw a 503 surge affecting the embeddings path (eu-west/us-west). Autoscaler didn't scale due to cooldown bug, ~18m of elevated errors. Mitigations applied: manual scale to 12 replicas, temporary routing to smaller model (redwood-mini), kv-cache warm; systems currently stable. No data loss, customer-visible errors for a subset of requests. incident link: https://incident.redwood.ai/INC-2026-042

incident-bot: PAGED: P1 - 503 Surge - embeddings-usw - triggered 2026-03-14T02:13Z - pages: 4 - timeline: spike -> autoscaler failed -> manual scale -> reroute -> resolved 02:31Z

maria: confirmed the root cause looks like OOM-driven KV eviction on embedding workers; autoscaler cooldown logic prevented the HPA from reacting. Tracked at https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/987 (root cause + repro). PR for fix queued, needs infra-owner deploy. Current metrics: p99 embeddings 480ms (baseline ~220ms), error-rate down to 0.6% from 4.2% after mitigations.

cheng: quick Q - who is primary/secondary for the next 12h and who owns model-routing if this flares up again?

alex: I'm primary until 11:00 UTC, maria is secondary, cheng you're backup for model routing. Sam will handle pager escalations if we exceed 3 pages in 30m. I updated rotation in the oncall app.

sam: ack, I'll monitor for flapping and handle customer escalations. Quick health checks for next shift (copy these):
  - curl -s https://api.redwood.ai/health | jq '.components.embeddings'
  - kubectl get hpa embeddings-pool -n inference
  - kubectl get deploy embeddings-pool -o yaml | yq '.spec.replicas'
  - grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/embed_pool (panels: error-rate, p95 latency, replica count)

maria: action items for handoff (please track):
  1) infra: deploy autoscaler cooldown fix (PR #1024) - owner: infra-oncall
  2) create temporary alert: embeddings error-rate >1% for 15m -> page to eng-oncall
  3) add canary routing for eu-west at 06:00 UTC to shift traffic to fallback model for 1h
  4) document the temporary routing + manual scale steps in the kv-eviction runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ONCALL/kv-eviction-runbook

oncall-bot: rotation updated: alex (primary) -> maria (secondary) -> cheng (backup). Reminder: escalate to oncall-manager if incident severity becomes P0.

alex: current status snapshot: services green, embed error-rate 0.2% last 10m, CPU/GPU util ~78% in us-west, manual replicas=12. Keeping manual scale in place until autoscaler fix deployed + validated. Next scheduled check 08:30 UTC. Please post any new pages in this thread and ping #eng-oncall for urgent escalations. :white_check_mark:

maria: leaving a handoff note for the incoming shift: attach config snapshot and checklist. I asked runbook-bot to snapshot state.

runbook-bot: Snapshot saved: embeddings-pool@2026-03-14T07:45Z - scaled_replicas=12 - routing_override=redwood-mini - autoscaler_version=v1.3.1

cheng: thanks. Notifying EU support contacts for customers who saw degraded responses. Also flagging a small coverage gap we have 10:00-11:00 UTC where fewer engineers are on rotation; alex can you extend or assign someone?

alex: I can extend primary to 12:00 UTC and assign sam as late backup 11:00-14:00 UTC. Adding that to the oncall calendar now.

sam: acknowledged, will be available 11:00-14:00 UTC.

alex: ok, handoff complete. Last health check at 07:52 UTC. Leaving the thread open for any follow-ups.
